# The lines of the suites under tests/ that name a name of tests/fixtures/deletion-list.txt on purpose, admitted by
# payload/scripts/one-reader-check.sh, which refuses every other such line it finds there.
# One entry for each line: <class>TAB<file>TAB<the whole line>. An entry admits one line of that file with that text,
# wherever it stands; an entry that admits no line is refused. The classes:
#   plant         a line a suite writes to prove a check finds the name
#   old run       text that builds a version-14 run for the reader, the translation or the act to read
#   refusal       a test that a retired verb or file is refused or gone, or the comment that says what it refuses
#   old home      a helper or world that still names an old record file beside the run's log
#   fixture text  a fixture's own text held inside a suite, naming what a run recorded
old run	tests/close-out-3.test.sh	  printf 'run/v1|ev=hand|ac=AC-1|what=waive-row|by=Chris Lehman|said=waive the row|at=2026-10-06\n' >> "$rec/run.log"
old run	tests/reader.test.sh	printf 'line/v1|ev=published|row=T1|commit=c1|kind=queue|by=-|why=-|at=2026-11-01T00:00:01Z\n' > "$HD/landing-proofs.log"
old run	tests/reader.test.sh	printf 'owed/v1|key=%s|state=open|sent=-|at=2026-11-01T00:00:0%s|title=t|reply=r\n' decide:D1 2 approve:x 3 > "$HD/asks.state"
